questions.question: If sec 4x = cosec (3x – 43°), then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

secθ = cosec(90°- θ)

**Calculation**

sec4x = cosec(3x - 43°)

⇒ cosec(90° - 4x) = cosec(3x - 43°)

⇒ 90° - 4x = 3x - 43°

⇒ 3x + 4x = 90° + 43°

⇒ 7x = 133°

⇒ x = 133°/7

∴ x = 19°

questions.question: How many such numbers are there from 500 to 750 (including both) which are neither divisible by 3 nor by 11?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Number divisible by 3 upto 500 = 500/3 = 166

Number divisible by 11 upto 500 = 500/11 = 45

Number divisible by 33 upto 500 = 500/33 = 15

Number divisible by 3 upto 750 = 750/3 = 250

Number divisible by 11 upto 750 = 750 / 11 = 68

Number divisible by 33 upto 750 = 750/33 = 22

⇒ Number divisible by 3 between 500 - 750 = 250 – 166 = 84

⇒ Number divisible by 11 between 500 - 750 = 68 – 45 = 23

⇒ Number divisible by 33 between 500 - 750 = 22 – 15 = 7

Total numbers from 500 to 750 = 250 + 1 = 251

∴ Required numbers = 251 – (84 + 23 – 7) = 151

questions.question: The average weight of a group of 10 girls is 48 kilograms. If 2 girls R and S, replace by P and Q then the new average weight is 46 kg. The weight of P is equal to the weight of Q and the weight of R is equal to the weight of S, another girl T joins the group and the new average weight of the group becomes 46 kg. The weight of T is equal to the weight of P. What is the weight (in kg) of R?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of 10 girls = 48 kg

**Formula:**

Average weight = Sum of weight/Total members

**Calculation: **

Total weight of 10 girls = 48 × 10 = 480 kg

After R and S gone then P and Q join the group then the average weight = 46 kg

Now, total weight of 10 girls = 46 × 10 = 460 kg

Weight, R = S and P = Q

According to the question,

480 – 2R + 2P = 460

⇒ R – P = 10 ----(i)

After entry of T in the group, the average weight of the group remains unaffected.

⇒ Weight of T = 46 kg

Weight, T = P = 46 kg ----(ii)

From (i) and (ii), we get

R – 46 = 10

∴ Weight of R = 56 kg

questions.question: The average of a set of 20 consecutive integers is 21.5. What is the largest integer in the set?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of consecutive integer = 21.5

**Formula:**

Average = Sum of numbers/Total numbers

**Calculation:**

Total sum of these number = 21.5 × 20 = 430

Let the smallest number x – 10

Set: (x – 10), (x – 9), (x – 8),……………..(x + 8), (x + 9)

According to the question,

20x – 10 = 430

⇒ 20x = 440

⇒ x = 22

∴ Largest number = x + 9 = 31

questions.question: A person goes to office at 1/5 (one-fifth) of the speed returning from his office. If his average speed during this entire journey is 20 km/h, then what is the speed (in m/s) of the person on his way to office?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average speed = 20 km/hr

**Formula:**

Speed = Distance/Time

Average speed = Total distance/Total time taken = 2S₁S₂/(S₁ + S₂)

Where, S₁ and S₂ are speed

**Calculation: **

Let the speed of the man returning from office be 5x units

⇒ Speed when going to office = 1/5 × 5x = x unit

According to the question,

(2 × x × 5x) / (x + 5x) = 20

⇒ 10x = 20 × 6

⇒ x = 12

∴ Speed when going to office = 12 km/hr = 12 × 5/18 = 10/3 m/s

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 48°. AB and AC is extended to points D and E respectively, if the bisectors of angle CBD and angle BCE meet at point O, then ∠BOC is equal to:

questions.question: Three sides of a square area are to be fenced. If the area of the field is 4900 m², then how many meters of fence will be required?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of field = 4900 m²

**Formula:**

Area of square = (side)²

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

4900 = (side)²

⇒ side = √4900

⇒ side = 70 m

Perimeter of three sides of the square = 70 × 3 = 210 m

∴ 210 m fence is required

questions.question: A shopkeeper bears an expenditure of Rs. 122 for the production of every item. He also incurs an additional expenditure of Rs. 27,000 which is not related to the number of items produced. He will have to sell the item for Rs. 225 during the season. If he fails to do so, he will have to sell each item for Rs. 75. If he produces 1500 items and is able to sell all the items produced, how much items do he sell during the season so that he does not make any profit or loss?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total items produce = 1500

During the season he sells the item at = Rs. 225

And after the season he sells the item at = Rs. 75

**Calculation:**

Expenditure to produce the items = 1500 × 122 = Rs. 183000

Additional expenditure on items = Rs. 27000

⇒ Total expenditure = (183000 + 27000) = Rs. 210000

Let the number of items sold during the season be ‘x’

According to the question,

225 × x + 75 × (1500 – x) = 210000

⇒ 225x + 112500 – 75x = 210000

⇒ 150x = 97500

⇒ x = 650

∴ Number of items sold during the season = 650

questions.question: A, B and C work together. The ratio of the work done by A and B together and the work done by C is 11 : 3, and the ratio of work done by B and C together and work done by A is 1: 1. Which of the three workers is the most skilful?

options.text: They all do the equal work.

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of work done, (A + B) : C = 11 : 3

Ratio of work done, (B + C) : A = 1 : 1

**Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

3A + 3B = 11C ----(i)

Also, B + C = A ----(ii)

Now put the value A in equation (i) from equation (ii)

3(B + C) + 3B = 11C

⇒ 6B = 8C

⇒ B : C = 4 : 3 (ratio of efficiency)

From (ii), we get

A = 4 + 3 = 7

∴ A has maximum efficiency so he is the most skilful.

questions.question: The ratio of the number of students passed in an examination to the number of students who failed was 25 : 4. If three more students appear in the examination and the number of failed students decreases by 3 compared to the earlier, then the ratio of the total number of students to the number of failed students currently becomes 8 : 1. The total number of students who appeared in the examination in the beginning were:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of students passed : Number of students failed = 25 : 4

**Calculation:**

Let the number of students passed and failed be 25x and 4x respectively

⇒ Number of students appeared = 25x + 4x = 29x

According to the question,

(29x + 3) / (4x – 3) = 8/1

⇒ 29x + 3 = 32x – 24

⇒ 3x = 27

⇒ x = 9

**∴ Actual number of students appeared = 29x = 261 **

questions.question: If the seven-digit number 35345xy is divisible by 40, then the least value of (4x + 5y) is:
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Factors of = 40 = 2³ × 5

In order to a number to be exactly divisible by 40, it must be divisible by 5 and 8 both

Check last 3-digits, they must be exactly divisible by 8

Last digit must be 5 or 0

**Calculation:**

Possible values of y = 0 and 5

5xy must be divisible by 8

∵ the number is also divisible by 8

⇒ Last digit (y) must be divisible by 2.

⇒ y = 0 (as 5 is not divisible by 8)

⇒ 5x0 must be divisible by 8

⇒ x = 2 or 6

∴ Least value of (4x + 5y) = 4 × 2 + 5 × 0 = 8

questions.question: The amount of Rs. 18000 is partially lent at 7% and the remaining amount at 9% per annum. If the average annual interest is 8.5%, then at 9% the amount given (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount = Rs. 18000

**Concept:**

If a part of the amount is offered at x% and other part at y% and average interest rate is k%

Then, the ratio of amount in the first part to second part = (y – k) : (k – x)

**Calculation:**

Ratio, Amount at 9% : Amount at 7% = (8.5 – 7) : (9 – 8.5) = 1.5 : 0.5 = 3 : 1

∴ Amount at 9% = 3/4 × 18000 = Rs. 13500

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys an item at 87% of its selling price and sells it at 12% above its selling price. His profit percentage (in nearest integer) is:
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

SP = (100 + x)/100 × CP (x = profit percent)

**Calculation: **

Let the selling price of an article be Rs 100

⇒ Shopkeeper buys it at = 87/100 × 100 = Rs 87

Shopkeeper sold it at = 112/100 × 100 = Rs. 112

⇒ Difference between buying and selling price = (112 – 87) = 25

∴ Required percent = (25/87) × 100

⇒ 28.73 ≈ 30%

questions.question: A tire has 3 punctures. The first puncture alone could expel the air of that tire in 7 minutes, second alone in 14 minutes and third alone in 28 minutes. If the air exits at a constant rate, then how much time (in minutes) will it take for all the punctures to expel the entire air from the tire?
questions.solution:
**Given:**** **

Puncture expel air in 7 min, 14 min, 28 min

**Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

Let the total capacity of tire be 28 units

⇒ Efficiency of 1st puncture = 28/7 = 4 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of 2ⁿd puncture = 28/14 = 2 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of 3rd puncture = 28/28 = 1 unit/min

∴ Required time = 28/(4 + 2 + 1) = 4 min

questions.question: A number is increased by 35% and then decreased by 25% and then increased by 15%. The total increase/decrease percent in the number (to the nearest integer) is?
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

If a number is increased by x%

⇒ New number = (100 + x)/100 × Actual number

**Calculation:**

Let the number be 100

⇒ 35% increase = 100 × 135/100 = 135

⇒ 25% decrease = {135 – (25/100) × 135} = (135 – 33.75) = 101.25

Now, 15% increase,

⇒ {101.25 + (15/100) × 101.25}

⇒ (101.25 + 15.18)

⇒ 116.43

∴ Required percent = (116.43 – 100)/100 × 100 = 16% increase

questions.question: If x⁸ – 727x⁴ + 1 = 0, then the possible value of x - (1)/(x) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x⁸ – 727x⁴ + 1 = 0

**Formula:**

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

**Calculation:**

Divide the equation by x⁴

x⁴ + 1/ x⁴ = 727

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² = 727 + 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 27

⇒ (x – 1/x)² + 2 = 27

⇒ (x – 1/x)² = 27 – 2 = 25

∴ x – 1/x = 5

questions.question: A person covers the same distance at 3 km/h, 4 km/h, 7 km/h and 12 km/h and it takes a total of 340 minutes to cover this distance. What is the total distance (in km) covered by him?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Total time = 340 min

**Formula:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Distance is coverd in 4 equal parts

Let total distance be 4x

According to the question,

x/3 + x/4 + x/7 + x/12 = 34/6

⇒ (28x + 21x + 12x + 7x)/84 = 34/6

⇒ 68x = 476

⇒ x = 7

∴ Total distance = 4x = 28 km

questions.question: A person bought an item without getting a discount of 28%, so he had to pay Rs. 1960 more. How much (in Rs.) did he pay for the material if he got the discount?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount paid extra for getting no discount = Rs. 1960

**Formula:**

Selling price = (100 – x)/100 × Marked price (x = discount percent)

**Calculation:**

Let marked price be ‘x’

⇒ x × 28/100 = 1960

⇒ x = Rs. 7000

∴ SP when the discount is offered = 72/100 × 7000 = Rs. 5040

questions.question: A can finish a work in 33 days and B can finish the same work in one-third of the time taken by A. By working together, how much of the same work can both of them finish in six days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A finish in 33 days

B finish in = 1/3 × 33 = 11 days

**Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be 33units

⇒ A’s efficiency = 33/33 = 1 units/day

⇒ B’s efficiency = 33/11 = 3 units/day

Work done in 6 days = 6 × (1 + 3) = 6 × 4 = 24 units

∴ Required answer = 24/33 = 8/11

questions.question: If the radius of a sphere is increased by 27%, then what will be the percentage increase (up to two decimal places) in its volume?
questions.solution:
**TGiven:**

Volume increased by 27%

**Concept Used:**

The volume of sphere ∝ R³

That is Vₒ/Vₙ = (Rₒ/Rₙ)³

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of sphere is 100 

Radius of new sphere is 127% of 100 

Now, Ro/Rn = 100/127 = 1/1.27

⇒ (Ro/Rn)3 = 1/2.04838

⇒ Vo/Vn = 1/2.04838

Now, Percentage increase in volume = [(Vn - Vo)/Vo] × 100%

⇒ [(2.04838 - 1)/1] × 100%

⇒ 1.04838 × 100% = 104.83%

**∴ The percentage increase in the volume is 104.83%.**
